description: An oil painting of a large ornate Gothic stone building on a cobbled street at dusk, its tall tracery windows full of flame with bookshelves visible inside and smoke billowing out. In the foreground a column of soldiers in spiked pickelhaube-style helmets with rifles marches past in silhouette, one carrying a torch. Uniforms and architecture suggest early 20th-century Europe. No letters, numbers or signature, no frame or border, and no blood or nudity.
reason: Shows German-style soldiers marching past a burning library in a wartime arson scene, but the card is about sodium citrate keeping donated blood from clotting. Repaint with blood storage, such as physicians in a 1914 hospital with a citrated blood flask and transfusion apparatus.
